overview: A transaction row people only read, such as a line of a statement. It has no hover, no focus stop and no callback.

default.title: Default
default.text: Content on the left, amount on the right and an optional leading icon. Group the rows inside `List`.

rules: Use Read Only only when the row has no action; any row that responds to a click is a Transaction List Action.
Don’t attach click handlers to a Read Only row.
Pass amounts formatted and without a sign; `amount.type` adds the sign and the color.
Place rows inside `List` and set `showDivider={false}` on the last row.
Use `disabled` for unavailable rows; never fade a row with opacity or custom classes.
Don’t rebuild the row with `div` and flex.
